subject: Efficient staff storage
hook: We're only a small team. Will you make storage for one room?
fb:
We're often asked by local business owners whether we only take on big office fit-outs.

We don't. We're just as happy making one room or even one piece: a run of cupboards in a staff room, a tea-point kitchenette, a set of lockers or a single tall supply cupboard that finally fits the alcove by the printer.

It's all designed for your space, made in our Hanley workshop and fitted by our own team, the same as a larger job. If you've got a small storage problem that's been bugging you, ask us about it here:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=productive-spaces-and-home-offices&utm_content=day-238
gbp:
Do you make storage for small businesses, or only full office fit-outs?

We make both. Alongside larger commercial projects, we also make single rooms and single pieces for small businesses: a run of staff room cupboards, a bank of personal lockers, a tea-point or kitchenette, coat storage by the entrance, or one tall supply cupboard built to fit an awkward alcove.

Every piece is designed around your space and how your team uses it, manufactured and assembled in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked, then delivered and installed by our own team. Finishes can be chosen to sit alongside your existing furniture.

The first step is a free, no-obligation consultation, followed by a measuring visit and an itemised quote with transparent pricing. Tap Learn more to get in touch about your workplace storage.
cta: Ask us about your small storage project
